title: 7 ## CRIME UNDFR DIFFERENT HEADS Table II shows the percentage break-up of total cognizable cases under important heads of crime for the entire country during the year 1964 to 1968. It appears that the pattern of percentage distribution of crime under important heads is more or less of the same nature during all these five years.
